newsitem.title: UK: European jet fuel business limited, Med mixed.
newsitem.headline: European jet fuel business limited, Med mixed.

text.p: Jet demand in North West Europe remained limited with little action seen on Wednesday, traders said.
The only buying interest heard was for speculative storage but refiners were holding back supplies, prefering to put barrels into their own storage and wait for firmer differentials against gas oil.
Overall prices gained a dollar on the day in line with gas oil futures in a "fairly balanced but dull" market, one trader commented.
Barges were assessed around August IPE +$16/18 a tonne fob ARA with cargoes up a similar amount at August IPE +$17/+$19 a tonne cif NWE.
In the Mediterranean the scene was more complex with sellers of small parcels looking for a $7.50 premium to quotes high while buyers remained one dollar lower.
High freight rates and the inability to put together a product combination cargo due to limited gas oil supplies made small jet parcels unattractive.
Those with large parcels such as Greek and Algerian grade sellers were looking for "double figures." Greek jet was heard fetching a premium of $10-12 internally.
